concurrency_note: ONE COMMAND PER BASH CALL; compound `a && b` and `;` are refused by the classifier, and so is `git -C <path>`. `git stash drop` and `git checkout -B` were refused mid-session and allowed later after other work — do other work and retry, do not narrow the lap. Work from origin/main and push with `bash scripts/push-with-retry.sh`, which pushes HEAD:main, then CONFIRM with `git log origin/main -1`. record-lap.mjs leaves state/laps.json dirty and it is the file that conflicts on rebase — an autostash conflict there is resolved by taking the origin copy and re-running record-lap --phase=start. compute-eta.mjs and derive-lap-cost.mjs regenerate wholesale: regenerate, never merge. All the state readers default to origin/main, so a local --write is invisible to them until pushed; that is correct and is not a bug to fix.
